principle: Root Logos builds one coherent account from independently governed evidence. Connection does not require possession, and interpretation never replaces source truth.

sources.name: FoldForge
sources.returns: Identity pressure, compositional methods, and new questions for Root Logos
sources.boundary: Root Logos may interpret public FoldForge evidence but may not rewrite FoldForge, its Ethereum evidence, or the meaning of held works.

sources.name: X
sources.receives: Public response and changing external conditions
sources.boundary: Platform metrics may inform observation but may not determine constitutional truth or authority.

sources.name: Telos
sources.receives: A deliberately published identity, active deployment posture, bounded organic acquisition loop, governing constraints, and anonymous measurement boundary
sources.returns: Evidence of whether a persistent acquisition system can move from discovery to qualified traffic and paid conversion truthfully, measurably, and under reviewed authority
sources.connection_message: Telos is present through a public constitutional witness and its first live acquisition route. Root Logos can learn from that bounded practice without receiving customer data, publication credentials, outreach authority, or spending power.
sources.boundary: Personal data, payment records, credentials, unpublished campaign artifacts, channel authority, outreach, advertising spend, deployment control, and conversion operations remain outside Root Logos.

sources.name: Sovereign Standard
sources.receives: A sealed public material-witness export carrying work hashes, preparation and mint state, public archive URLs, ledger witnesses, and explicit Black Tin Vessel relations
sources.returns: Material tests of coherence, stewardship, preparation, embodiment, and archival continuity
sources.connection_message: Sovereign Standard is present through its public product canon and vessel field. Private collector and order records remain outside the connection.
sources.boundary: Private customer, order, claim, registry, and community records remain outside Root Logos by default.

sources.name: FoldPortrait
sources.role: Deterministic structural self-portraiture and completed render lineage
sources.receives: A completed public render ledger bound to Sovereign Standard archive objects by artifact identity and content-addressed witnesses
sources.returns: Visible tests of structural identity, iteration, materialization, and continuity
sources.connection_message: FoldPortrait is present through its completed render archive. Each render appears only where its identity agrees with the corresponding Sovereign Standard material witness.
sources.boundary: Root Logos receives no authority to generate new portraits, alter the completed archive, mint tokens, exercise custody, or infer private stewardship.
